scope: Proposition 6.3 (Pages and tested images) of the manuscript “Counterexamples to weak chromatic splitting: sphere kernels and descent exponents” (preprints/Counterexamples-to-weak-chromatic-splitting-sphere-kernels-and-descent-exponents-September-27-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 318 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 f646b6facb641430), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 12. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For any exact Φ : C → Sp and integer b ≥ 1: (i) If V has A-exponent at most b, then Es,q b+1 = 0 for all s ≥ b and q. (ii) If V has some finite A-exponent and Es,q 2 = 0 for all s ≥ b and q, then πdΦ(eb(V )) = 0 for every d. The second assertion is zero tested image, not nullity of a map.
